item.title: 225Fest brings Baton Rouge together in celebration of community
item.description: 225Fest once again filled downtown Baton Rouge with live music, food trucks, local vendors, and families looking to celebrate the Capital Region, offering a chance to pause, reconnect, and focus on the positive.

item.title: Gonzales man dies in Baton Rouge motorcycle crash
item.description: A 43-year-old man was killed in a motorcycle crash in East Baton Rouge Parish on Saturday afternoon, after he hit the rear of a Kia Soul and was ejected from his motorcycle.

item.title: AG Liz Murrill: Louisiana man accused of indecent behavior, grooming of minor
item.description: Louisiana Bureau of Investigation agents arrested a Louisiana man accused of indecent behavior with a juvenile and other charges, according to Attorney General Liz Murrill.

item.title: Report: 86 DACA recipients deported by ICE in 2025
item.description: The Department of Homeland Security admitted to Congress that it apprehended 261 DACA recipients "with criminal records" in 2025 resulting in 86 deportations

item.title: Attorneys work to free immigrants from Louisiana detention
item.description: The ACLU of Louisiana is using the centuries-old law of Habeas Corpus to challenge the detention of immigrants in Louisiana, which has the second-highest number of incarcerated immigrants in the country, and is working to liberate those who have been wrongfully detained.

item.title: Louisiana OMV warns residents of scam texts
item.description: The Louisiana Office of Motor Vehicles (OMV) is warning residents of scam texts that threaten suspension of vehicle registration for outstanding tickets or fees, and advises people to avoid clicking on links in unsolicited messages, not to respond with personal information, and to report suspicious texts to the FTC.

item.title: Baton Rouge house fire causes $200K loss
item.description: The Baton Rouge Fire Department responded to a house fire that caused an estimated loss of $200,000, with no one home at the time and three dogs escaping safely.

item.title: St. George residents help shape vision for Comprehensive Plan 2050
item.description: City leaders in St. George are seeking input from residents to help shape the city's Comprehensive Plan 2050, which will serve as a long-term roadmap for the city's growth and development over the next 25 years.

item.title: 22 killed, more than 120 wounded as protesters try to storm US Consulate in Pakistan
item.description: The violence came after the United States and Israel attacked Iran, killing its Supreme Leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei.

item.title: Three US service members killed, five seriously wounded in Iran operation: Military
item.description: They are the first reported American casualties since the U.S. and Israel launched a surprise attack on Iran.
